# Content verification for RF-01..RF-03 (your qitem-20261004042321-d8871e6b)

You were right not to treat these as hash drift. All three are later, deliberate corrections that were reviewed
when made. Rule (same for qa-agent's 02-analytics item 10): verify the change against its evidence; if the
original slice's own claim still holds, re-affirm the item, and have the receipt name the later commit and its
review, stating that it does not accept the later content on this slice's behalf. If the later content is wrong,
fail it to me as a finding instead.

| Finding | Item | The later change and where it was judged |
|---|---|---|
| RF-01 | 03-operate #5, #13 | W2-03 (LOW, mission 01 backlog: disk meter on the loopback scrape) was fixed by mission 02's `03-dogfood-fix`, merged at `5c264db` after QA and review; its GAPS row was closed with that slice's evidence at `33c5b44a` (`docs(03-dogfood-fix): record schema and disk-gauge verification`). |
| RF-02 | 02-click-retention #5 | My closure of the interim click and user_agent_class audit-column rows at 04-audit-columns' integrate: `17593aa`, seat-name correction `382a7b2`. You accepted 04-audit-columns item 5 on exactly those rows (receipt 12, `bc9bb29`). |
| RF-03 | 02-click-retention #10 | `bfc642d`, design-agent's correction of the ADR-0011/0018 shutdown wording (writer shutdownNow can interrupt after its drain deadline; purge never interrupts), approved by me before commit (mission 02 NOTES 23:33Z); finding W2P-01 in the wave pre-review `82340b8`, accepted as resolved, and in the final wave review `bd74b509`. The DESIGN §7 ADR-0018 row's purge-hold mention comes from design-agent's register upkeep (`2d3de57` / `3b2ecd0b`). |

Pin `30f8de4e`. Plain `rig proof judge` lines, non-missions paths slice-relative. Add the outcome to
`docs/qa/final-reaffirmation/qa2.md`; close with the receipt numbers and each slice's readiness.
summary: Content verification for RF-01..03 (03-operate #5 #13, 02-click-retention #5 #10): later reviewed corrections, with their evidence
